title: Batch manifest
description: Immutable record of one launch of the pipeline. A batch groups the runs one press of Start (or one local `pipeline run`) created, so the runs of one launch are read together and never interleave with another launch. It carries no run identity: every run below it has its own manifest.

command.description: The local runner command that started the batch; null for a batch the master workflow started.

config.description: The launch configuration as the orchestration recorded it (the master's `config`, or the resolved local config). Kept whole so a batch can be told apart from another by what was asked for, not only by when.
